title: Body found in impounded Tesla that of missing teenage girl, LA officials say
summary: Celeste Rivas, 15, found dead in Hollywood tow lot in vehicle reportedly registered to singer d4vd A decomposed body found inside an impounded Tesla that reportedly belonged to the singer d4vd has been identified as that of a teenage girl who went missing more than a year ago. The Los Angeles county medical examiner’s office confirmed that the body found inside the vehicle at a tow lot in Hollywood on 8 September was that of Celeste Rivas, 15. Officials have not determined her cause of death, but the LAPD is considering the death a homicide . Continue reading...
